text: Chose OTLP logs over metrics for the invocation record: a discrete event with typed attributes is a log record, and aggregate counters would be metrics on a different path with a different request message. Assumed a receiver that accepts OTLP/HTTP JSON on /v1/logs is the common case; a gRPC-only or protobuf-only endpoint needs a collector in front, which the earlier draft's 'every OTLP receiver' claim obscured
